summary: Configured node1 (RHEL 10) to run a rootless Podman container as the unprivileged user appsvc, serving on port 8080, autostarting at boot via a systemd --user Quadlet unit with linger enabled (no active login session required). Verified end-to-end across a full node reboot, including boot-identity change proof.
actions_performed: Confirmed no pre-existing podman/docker or appsvc account on node1 (cmd-77bf70f5cb0147ef)
Installed podman, slirp4netns, fuse-overlayfs via dnf (cmd-e210eff037ad414f)
Created unprivileged user appsvc with auto-assigned subuid/subgid ranges and enabled loginctl linger (cmd-4ef7e32bd2ae4f54)
Started user@1000.service to obtain a user D-Bus/systemd session for setup (cmd-235c7cc3e12344ee)
Pulled httpd:alpine as appsvc via rootless podman (cmd-7fa5e8b6c79c4347)
Ran container mapped to 8080 and confirmed HTTP 200 locally and via NODE_IP (cmd-6784cc965ce6490f)
Replaced ad-hoc container with a Quadlet unit (~appsvc/.config/containers/systemd/webapp.container) for boot-persistent, declarative systemd-managed rootless container (cmd-3a481e6d3d3d474b)
Reloaded user systemd daemon, started webapp.service, confirmed active/running with port bound (cmd-968072091ca543b7)
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id f455a75c-..., container webapp Up with 8080->80 mapping (cmd-a12dcf0a4c3e4554)
Issued deferred systemctl reboot so acknowledgement returned before disconnection (cmd-be4d5e47827848ed), observed connection reset/timeout during reboot (cmd-f09a200886de46db, cmd-b8c3c784791540eb)
Polled node1 until reachable again and captured new boot_id d2493eaa-... proving the restart occurred (cmd-ad8a1e56b12d4ac7)

Post-restart: confirmed `who` shows no logged-in users (only the linger-created manager pseudo-session), webapp.service active since shortly after boot, container running with correct port mapping, and HTTP 200 served on 8080 (cmd-313ab56c9f75421e)

evidence.requirement: Unprivileged appsvc account created and used to run the container
evidence.summary: appsvc did not exist beforehand; created as UID 1000 with no elevated privileges, and rootless podman commands executed as this user (sudo -u appsvc) pulled and ran the container.
curl to NODE_IP:8080 and localhost:8080 returned HTTP 200 both before and after the systemd-unit conversion and after the full node reboot.

evidence.requirement: Service starts at boot while appsvc has no active login session
evidence.summary: loginctl linger enabled for appsvc; webapp.container Quadlet unit installed under ~appsvc/.config/containers/systemd with WantedBy=default.target so systemd auto-generates and starts webapp.service in the user manager. After reboot, `who` shows zero logged-in users (only the linger-spawned manager session, no tty/login), yet webapp.service is active and the container is serving traffic — proving boot start without an interactive session.

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart evidence protocol: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id f455a75c-ec12-49a8-a647-c2be3f67c08c with webapp container healthy; issued deferred `systemctl reboot` whose ack returned before disconnect; observed connection drop confirming the restart in progress; post-restart boot_id d2493eaa-fcd4-4f38-86e9-60a8efe6b960 proves a genuine reboot (different from baseline); confirmed webapp.service and container recovered automatically and are serving HTTP 200, with no active login session for appsvc.
